title: 第948章 岩浆底部神秘强者第947章 朱果到手血神现身
lines: 巨大的岩浆手掌，朝着血神抓了过去。
“就让本神看看，你究竟是何方神圣？！”
血神冲天而起，一拳轰出，将那一只岩浆大手给击碎。
紧接着，他身形一闪，朝着岩浆冲了过去，眨眼间便没入岩浆之中。
熔岩空间中，众多道台境强者看着下方只剩下震荡的岩浆，呆愣在了原地。
刚才发生的一幕，深深的震撼了他们。
他们根本不知道，这岩浆深处，竟然还藏有神秘强者。
“那朱果，我们还要去夺回来吗？”
老莫身边的一位老者轻声道。
他的脸上露出一丝颓丧。
朱果就这么被人抢走了，自己这么多年算是白等了。
“夺回来？你进去试试看？
那岩浆中的存在，丝毫不比刚才那家伙弱，我们进去，恐怕连渣都剩不下！”
尸魂宗的一位道台境强者冷哼一声回应道。
现场顿时陷入了沉默之中。
不管是刚才忽然出现，夺取熔炎朱果的那家伙，还是隐藏在熔炎深处的神秘强者，都远不是他们能抵抗的。
“先离开吧，此地已经没有任何待下去的必要了……”
老莫叹息了一声，虽然心有不甘，但他也知道，这朱果终究还是与自己无缘啊。
随即几位道台境的强者纷纷化作流光，从熔炎空间上方的空洞冲出，消失在了天际。
火兽和烈焰雄鹰相视一眼，也纷纷咆哮着离去。
到了八级妖兽级别，它们的灵智与普通人类无异。
实力相差不大的情况下，若无生死大仇或者逆天机缘，相互之间是不会轻易死斗的。
道台境一旦受伤，想要恢复，都是以数十年甚至数百年时间来计算的。
受伤期间，一旦碰到劲敌，很大概率会被强敌斩杀。
妖兽向来以强者为尊，受伤后，更容易被自己的手下取而代之。
没多久，整个熔炎空间中，就只剩下尸魂宗的人了。
而原本激活法宝护住自身的安若惜却忽然撤掉了法宝。
紧接着，所有的尸魂宗强者纷纷落在了她面前。
“拜见少宗主！”
众人齐声喊道。
“诸位长老不用多礼，此番计划虽然没有成功，但那苏峰依旧还在这平原之中。
你们去平原出口守着，切不可让他逃了……”
content_en:
The huge magma palm grabbed at the Blood God.
"Let me see, who are you?!"
The Blood God rose into the sky and punched out, shattering the big magma hand.
Immediately afterwards, he flashed and rushed towards the magma, and was submerged into the magma in the blink of an eye.
In the lava space, many Daotai realm powerhouses looked at the shaking magma below and froze in place.
The scene that just happened deeply shocked them.
They had no idea that there was a mysterious and powerful man hiding deep in the magma.
"Then Zhu Guo, do we still want to take it back?"
An old man beside Lao Mo said softly.
There was a trace of depression on his face.
Zhu Guo was just snatched away, and he had waited all these years in vain.
"Take it back? You go in and try?
The existence in the magma is no weaker than the guy just now. If we go in, not even the scum will be left! "
A Taoist realm expert from the Corpse Soul Sect responded with a cold snort.
The scene suddenly fell into silence.
Whether it was the guy who suddenly appeared just now to seize the Molten Flame Zhuguo, or the mysterious strong man hiding in the depths of the Molten Flame, they were far from being able to resist.
"Leave first, there is no need to stay here anymore..."
Lao Mo sighed. Although he was unwilling to do so, he also knew that this Zhu Guo was not destined for him after all.
Immediately, several powerful men in the Taoist realm turned into streams of light, rushed out of the hole above the molten flame space, and disappeared into the sky.
The fire beast and the flaming eagle looked at each other and roared away.
At the eighth level of monsters, their intelligence is no different from that of ordinary humans.
When there is not much difference in strength, unless there is a life-or-death feud or a fate-defying chance, they will not easily fight to the death.
Once someone in the Daotai realm is injured, it will take decades or even hundreds of years to recover.
While injured, once you encounter a strong enemy, you will most likely be killed by it.
Monsters have always respected the strong, and after being injured, they are more likely to be replaced by their own men.
Not long after, only people from the Soul Soul Sect were left in the entire Molten Flame Space.
But An Ruoxi, who originally activated the magic weapon to protect herself, suddenly removed the magic weapon.
Immediately afterwards, all the strong men of the Corpse Soul Sect fell in front of her.
"Greetings to the Young Sect Master!"
Everyone shouted in unison.
"Elders, there is no need to be polite. Although this plan did not succeed, Su Feng is still in this plain.
You go and guard the exit of the plain, and you must not let him escape..."
"Yes!"
title_en: Chapter 948 The Mysterious Strong Man at the Bottom of the Magma Chapter 947 The Blood God Appears after Obtaining the Zhu Guo
